focus: media URL scheme guard (anti-SSRF / anti-XSS, Decision 6)
summary: Preview panel renders all backend-escaped text/caption exclusively via {{ }} interpolation; no v-html / innerHTML anywhere (static test guard enforces this). FILE :href is gated behind an http(s) scheme check that rejects file://, data:, javascript: and opaque file_id tokens. One defense-in-depth/consistency gap (single IMAGE :src lacked the scheme guard the ALBUM items already had) was fixed during the audit.

owasp_checks.A03-injection-xss: PASS — text/caption text-only via {{ }}; static source guard (no v-html=/.innerHTML=); hostile-payload test asserts 0 injected elements
owasp_checks.A10-ssrf: PASS — frontend never dereferences media URLs server-side; clickable :href and now :src are http(s)-only; file_id/non-http never become a request target
owasp_checks.A01-access-control: N/A — read-only preview, project scope enforced server-side
owasp_checks.secrets: PASS — no hardcoded secrets; PreviewStepResponse contract excludes ownerChatId/identity (Decision 8)

findings.finding: The single IMAGE block bound :src=block.mediaUrl WITHOUT the http(s) scheme guard that the ALBUM items already applied. An opaque file_id or a non-http scheme (e.g. data:image/svg+xml) would be set as the . For , javascript:/data: do not execute scripts (browsers script-disable img-loaded SVG), so this was NOT an XSS sink — but it was an inconsistency and a defense-in-depth/anti-SSRF gap (a doomed request, and divergence from Decision 6 'file_id -> icon').
findings.fix: Added isHttpUrl(block.mediaUrl) to the IMAGE v-if so a file_id / non-http src renders the neutral icon placeholder instead, matching ALBUM items. Added a regression test covering file_id / data: / javascript: IMAGE srcs.
findings.reason: Consistency + defense-in-depth: keep ALL media :src/:href behind one scheme guard so no untrusted scheme ever reaches the DOM as a load target.

findings.finding: FILE link uses target=_blank with rel='noopener noreferrer nofollow' + referrerpolicy='no-referrer'.
findings.reason: Reverse-tabnabbing and referrer-leak already mitigated correctly.
